# SALIS AUTO — Dependency Graph

What must land before what. Every edge is a technical dependency with its reason, not a preference.

## Waves

| Wave | Name | Requires | Agents | Exit condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| W0 | Reconnaissance | — | 01, 02 | Registry, gap report, dependency graph, ownership and risk register exist and regenerate cleanly. |
| W1 | Foundation | W0 | 04, 05, 06, 07 | Primitives, server + schema + RLS, auth and authz, test harness — all stable and merged. |
| W2 | Product | W1 | 08, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17 | Every domain capability implemented against real endpoints. |
| W3 | Hardening | W2 partial | 18, 19, 20, 21, 22 | Sweeps current with W2 — starts as soon as any capability is reviewable, not after the last one. |
| W4 | Integration | W2, W3 | 03, 23 | Full regression green; no regression carried forward. |
| W5 | Certification | W4 | 03, 24 | Every gate passes; certification report generated from the registry. |

## Critical path

`G1 registry` → `G2 foundation` → `G3 backend` → `G4/G5 core chain` → `W3 sweeps` → `W4 regression` → `W5 certification`

## Edges

| Blocks | Because |
|---|---|
| **G1 registry** → everything | Route tables, route tests, coverage and the release gates are generated from it. Building screens first means hand-maintaining hundreds of route checks. |
| **G2 modal + form system** → every create/edit/delete flow | 23 CTAs are inert today. Without a modal there is nowhere for a form to live, so no CRUD can be built. |
| **G2 shells** → G10 portals, G11 website | PublicShell, PortalShell and KioskShell do not exist. Portal screens have no chrome to render inside. |
| **G3 server + schema + RLS** → every capability's Definition of Done | Real data, persistence, audit and server-side authorization are DoD clauses. No screen can be certified before this exists. |
| **G3 auth lifecycle** → G10 portals | Portals are separate audiences with their own sessions; they cannot be built against a session model that does not exist. |
| **G3 contract package** → G13 API contract tests | Contract tests assert both sides import one Zod schema. Without the package there is nothing to assert against. |
| **G4 customers + vehicles** → G5 workshop chain | A job card references a customer and a vehicle. The Mini ERP chain cannot start from records that do not persist. |
| **G5 job cards + estimates** → G7 invoicing | An invoice is raised from a completed job card; the business invariant forbids invoicing without one. |
| **G6 inventory reservations** → G5 repair stage | Parts are reserved before repair and consumed during it. Without stock movements the chain has a hole in the middle. |
| **G7 ledger** → G7 reports | Report aggregates must come from the API over the ledger, not client arithmetic over one page of rows. |
| **G2 Charts extraction** → G7 reports, G9 BI | BarList and Donut are trapped inside accounting/Reports.tsx; every other chart screen would otherwise copy them. |
| **G2 CalendarView** → AppointmentCalendar, CRMCalendar, Workshop Calendar, Staff Scheduling | Four screens need one calendar. Building it four times is how the duplicate-component rule gets broken. |
| **G2 DetailPage** → the nine detail screens | One scaffold — header, meta, tabs, related records, timeline, activity rail, audit — reused rather than nine variants. |
| **G12 feature map** → nothing | Deliberately last among product work: the kit already renders these, so they are the safest work to defer and the easiest to parallelise. |
| **W3 mobile sweep** → W5 certification | Mobile is a DoD clause on every screen; certification cannot run against unverified layouts. |
| **W4 golden paths** → W5 certification | A failing critical golden path is an absolute release blocker regardless of any score. |
| **backup restore drill** → W5 certification | A backup that has never been restored is not a verified backup. |

## Safe to run concurrently

- G4 customers · G6 inventory · G11 website · G12 feature map
- G7 accounting · G9 admin · G10 portals

## Known contention points

| File | Note |
|---|---|
| `app/src/routes/index.tsx` | Every product agent adds routes here. Once the registry drives the route table this stops being a contention point — which is why G1 comes first. |
| `app/src/data/repository.ts` | Agent 05 owns it; product agents consume it. Changes are requested, not made. |
| `app/src/data/generated/ar.ts` | Agent 19 owns translations; product agents supply English keys and request the Arabic. |
